email_subject: Application - Social Media Specialist at Stanley/Stella
email_body:
Dear Stanley/Stella team,

I'm applying for the Social Media Specialist role. While my current title is Junior Digital Marketer, I've spent the past year running paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads, managing budgets, testing creatives, and reporting on ROI for client websites at Episto. I also built and optimized mirook.com, where I used structured data and AI search optimization to grow visibility.

I'm drawn to Stanley/Stella's commitment to sustainability and its B2B2C model. I understand how to adapt global campaigns for local markets, and I'm comfortable using data to reallocate budgets and improve lead quality. I'm currently deepening my HubSpot and marketing automation skills, and I speak English, Turkish, and Dutch (B1).

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help drive measurable growth across your European markets.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media Specialist position at Stanley/Stella. Your mission to redefine responsible fashion resonates deeply with me, and I'm excited by the opportunity to lead paid social campaigns that drive both awareness and measurable business results across European markets.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage paid social and search campaigns for client websites. I plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Meta and Google Ads, from audience segmentation to creative testing and budget reallocation. I use data from Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to identify insights and improve ROI. For a cleaning-services client, I also maintain CRM records and follow-up, giving me hands-on experience in lead management and nurturing.

Beyond paid media, I built and optimized mirook.com, a WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project sharpened my ability to use technology—including AI tools—to enhance campaign creation and reporting.

I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I'm comfortable adapting global campaigns to local market needs. I'm currently expanding my skills in HubSpot and marketing automation, and I'm eager to apply them to build automated lead nurturing workflows.

Stanley/Stella's entrepreneurial spirit and commitment to excellence align with my own approach. I'd love to bring my paid media expertise and curiosity for new technologies to your team, helping to turn campaigns into lasting business outcomes.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your digital marketing efforts.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
